title: A one-step kinetics-based rapid sandwich ELISA procedure using leach-proof antibody immobilization for the highly-sensitive detection of human fetuin A
protocol: Incubate the MTP well surface with 100 μL of 1% \(w/v) KOH in DIW for 10 min at 37°C.
Wash five times with 300 μL DIW per well.
Mix EDC-activated anti-HFA capture Ab \(8 µg mL\(^{-1}\)) with 1% \(v/v\) APTES in a ratio of 1:1 \(v/v).
Incubate each desired MTP well with 100 μL of the prepared anti-HFA capture Ab solution at 4 µg mL\(^{-1}\) in 0.5% APTES for 30 min at 37°C.
Wash five times with 300 μL of 0.1M PBS, pH 7.4.
Block the MTP wells by incubating with 300 μL of 1% \(w/v\) BSA for 30 min at 37°C.
Filter the BSA solution before use to remove contaminants.
Wash five times with 300 μL of 0.1M PBS, pH 7.4.
Dispense 100 µL of biotinylated anti-HFA detection Ab at 0.17 µg/mL into MTP wells.
Prepare HFA concentrations in BSA-preblocked sample vials to minimize analyte loss due to non-specific surface binding.
Add 100 µL of varying concentrations of HFA (0.1-243 ng/mL) to the MTP wells containing biotinylated anti-HFA detection Ab.
Wash the resulting sandwich immune complex-bound MTP with 300 µL of 0.1M PBS, pH 7.4 five times.
Add 100 µL of TMB-H2O2 mixture to each MTP well and incubate at room temperature for 14 min.
Stop the enzymatic reaction by adding 50 µL of 2N H2SO4 to each MTP well.
Record the absorbance at a primary wavelength of 450 nm, with 540 nm as the reference wavelength in a Tecan Infinite M200 Pro microplate reader.
